From Jonas (market-risk bulletin):
- At least $12,000,000 (60% of $20M) must be held in sovereign bills
- No single sovereign-bill issuer exposure exceeding $7,000,000

From Elena (collateral-return forecast):
- $8,000,000 overnight liquidity reserve required
- Maximum 30-day maturity for remaining reinvestment
- Settlement must include a commitment with type 'overnight_liquidity_monitoring'

These constraints clearly make the preliminary plan (full $20M in a single 90-day bank deposit) non-compliant on multiple fronts. Under our normal pre-trade process, this check-in has identified constraints the preliminary plan does not meet, so I will authorize a revised plan.

Here is the revised plan I intend to approve:
- $8,000,000 in an overnight liquidity reserve
- $12,000,000 in sovereign bills, split across at least two issuers with no single issuer exceeding $7,000,000 (e.g., $7,000,000 in one sovereign issuer and $5,000,000 in another)
- Maximum 30-day maturity for the non-overnight portion
- Include the 'overnight_liquidity_monitoring' commitment in the settlement

This satisfies all stated constraints. I'll formalize this as the settlement decision now.
